title: Booking Mugshot - Lena Moretti (Front and Right Profile)
prompt:
1) Function: Create a neutral, fictitious booking mugshot-style photograph showing a front view and a right profile within a single frame for identification documentation.
2) Scene / Composition: A plain, matte light-gray wall background with even forensic-flash illumination and no visible seams or props. The subject is a faceless, identity-neutral adult figure (no recognizable facial features/biometrics), centered, standing upright at eye level, wearing a plain solid-color crewneck shirt with no logos or patterns. Compose as a single image split into two adjacent halves: left half front-facing, right half right-profile, aligned by shoulder height. Subject occupies ~70% of the frame height, with modest headroom and clear shoulder outline; no text boards, height charts, or annotations.
3) Angle & Distance: angle_deg 0; distance_m 1.6.
4) Optics & Technique: 50mm lens, f/8, 1/125 s, ISO 200, white balance 5600K; sharp focus on head-and-shoulders silhouette; deep enough DOF to keep both halves equally crisp; minimal noise, professional quality, true-to-life color.
5) Mandatory elements (labels/markers/timestamps already present in the case): None.
6) Negatives (objective list of what MUST NOT appear): real person; recognizable face; eyes/iris detail; fingerprints; tattoos; scars; bruises; blood; injuries; any name text; booking numbers; barcodes; police department names; official badges; watermarks; logos/brands; background signage; height chart; measurement scale; date/time stamps; any caseId/evidenceId text; cameras/CCTV overlays; license plates; weapons.
7) Acceptance checklist (objective, verifiable bullets): - Single color documentary photo with two side-by-side views (front and right profile) in one frame.
- Eye-level perspective with neutral gray background and even forensic-flash lighting.
- Subject is non-identifiable with no discernible facial biometrics and no text/annotations present.
- Plain clothing with no logos; no brands, badges, or signage.
- Image is sharp, color, professional quality, and free of watermarks or overlays.
